description: Web search via DuckDuckGo's public HTML results page: ranked titles, direct result URLs and snippets, no ads. No relevance score (DuckDuckGo does not publish one). DuckDuckGo often answers with an empty page; the tool retries, and if it still gets none the list is empty and 'note' says so. Choose this tool for: Web search via DuckDuckGo's public HTML results page. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_live_page_diff (Compares a public page now with its earliest Internet); agent_intel_reader_markdown_extract (Reader view of one public https page: its <title>). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: agent_intel_web_search_turbo
